name: Can new drywall match my existing walls and texture?
description: Yes, but texture matching takes skill. The closer the crew can match the existing finish, the more seamless the new room will look.

mainEntity.name: Can new drywall match my existing walls and texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching the existing wall texture is often the hardest part of an addition, especially in homes with older or custom finishes. A good finish crew should be able to blend the new surfaces so the addition looks like it belongs with the rest of the house.
